item.title: Naked Comedy Show returns to Center City with nude stand-up on Valentine’s Day
item.description: Looking for unconventional Valentine’s Day plans? The Naked Comedy Show is celebrating one year of sold-out performances in Philadelphia with two special shows on Friday, Feb. 14, at The Velvet Whip in Center City.

item.title: N.J. appeals court upholds decision to dismiss racketeering charges against George Norcross, 5 others
item.description: A New Jersey appellate court will not reinstate racketeering charges against George E. Norcross III and five codefendants who had been accused running a criminal enterprise to wield influence and secure development projects Camden waterfront.

item.title: 5 events happening in Philly this weekend
item.description: Subzero wind chills are in the forecast, but that hasn’t slowed down the city’s weekend plans. For those willing to bundle up and brave the cold, there’s no shortage of things to do around the region.

item.title: Upside and downside to Sean Mannion as new Eagles offensive coordinator
item.description: There are reasons to be very encouraged by the Eagles' hiring of Sean Mannion as their new offensive play caller, and reasons to be skeptical. We looked at both.

item.title: Jalen Hurts named Pro Bowl replacement for NFC
item.description: Eagle QB Jalen Hurts will replace Rams QB Matthew Stafford in the Pro Bowl Games.

item.title: DeVon-tails Smith and 8 other dogs from Philly-area shelters are competing in the Puppy Bowl
item.description: Nine dogs from shelters in the Philly region are competing in the 2026 Puppy Bowl on Sunday. Feb. 8 at 2 p.m. One is named DeVon-tails Smith after the Eagles wide receiver.

item.title: Joel Embiid, Paul George not listed on injury report for Sixers-Pelicans on Saturday
item.description: Exactly two years to the day of the torn meniscus that changed everything, Joel Embiid is in the midst of his most consistent stretch of basketball since Jan. 30, 2024.

item.title: Urban Outfitters' discount Reclectic shop is moving from Franklin Mall to Willow Grove
item.description: URBN's discount shop Reclectic is moving out of Franklin Mall in Northeast Philly. It will reopen in Willow Grove Park Mall on Feb. 27. The store sells new and used items from Anthropologie, Urban Outfitters, Nuuly and Free People.

item.title: Regal abruptly closes retro-styled Cross Keys theater in South Jersey
item.description: The Regal Cross Keys Stadium 12 movie theater has abruptly closed. Theater in the Turnersville section of Washington Township opened in December 1994. Another Regal-owned theater nearby, the Regal UA Washington Township, remains open.

item.title: Abrupt removal of President's House slavery exhibits was pulling 'pages out of a history book with a razor'
item.description: A federal judge made no official decision Friday on whether the recently removed President's House slavery exhibits will be able to be displayed again, but she said nothing more can be taken from the site on Independence Mall.
